answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake in a vault before it may transact, slashed on provable misbehavior. The lock is the cost: cloning a thousand identities means funding a thousand vaults, while an honest agent pays only opportunity cost. Reputation then rides on a signal that is hard to fake - sustained, verifiable service history tied to one staked identity, like a lotus that blooms only after a season of rooted growth. Cheap clones earn no trust and no work.
